paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that chimes when an agent finishes answering.
# Response Chime
Hear when the agent has finished answering.

Send a prompt, walk away, and a chime plays when the turn ends. It rings for a
long plan-and-goal ru

n, for the moment an agent stops to ask you something, and
for a turn that finishes while you are re

ading another conversation, so you can
stop checking the tab.

The speaker row sits above **Settings** at the foot of the left sidebar. Click it
to open **Audio se

ttings**. That is where you turn the chime on or off, set the
volume, choose one of four sounds, add

a WAV or MP3 of your own, or keep it quiet
while you are looking at the page.

Nothing is uploaded. The built-in sounds are generated in your browser, and a
custom file stays in t
his browser's storage.
## What you can do

- **Hear an answer land.** A chime plays the moment a Session that was working
goes idle. A turn you

left running calls you back when it finishes.
- **Open the audio settings panel.** The speaker row

shows **On** or **Off** in
the wide sidebar. Click it to open the panel.
- **Pick a sound.** Chime,

Bell, Drop and Soft. Clicking one plays it, so you
hear the change before you rely on it.
- **Use yo

ur own sound.** Add a WAV or MP3 up to 5 MB and 30 seconds. It is
decoded and kept in this browser,

then played at the volume you set.
- **Set the level.** The slider goes from silent to full. All fou

r sounds and any
custom clip are normalized to the same level. So changing the sound does not
change

the volume. At 100% it is about as loud as a normal notification.
- **Stay quiet while you are watc

hing.** Turn on **Only when this window is in
the background** and the chime only plays when the pag

e is hidden or another
window has focus.
- **Keep it set.** Your choices are saved in this browser a

nd apply to every
conversation in the app.
## Install
You need the DeepSeek Harness, running in a browser or the desktop app.

1. Open **Plugins** in the left sidebar.
2. Press **Install**.
3. Paste this repository's address:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
4. Install it, then refresh the page.

If you work from a local copy, clone the repository and paste the folder's full
path instead. The in

stall dialog accepts a GitHub address, a package name, or a
local folder.
The plugin stays in your Harness for every session until you remove it.
## Using it

The speaker row sits above **Settings**. In the wide sidebar it shows the current
state next to the

speaker; in the narrow rail it becomes a round button. The icon
shows sound waves when the chime is
on and a small × when it is off.

1. Click the row to open **Audio settings**.
2. **Play a sound** turns the chime on and off. Turning

it back on plays the
current sound as a preview.
3. **Volume** sets how loud it plays. The value sa

ves as you drag.
4. **Sound** lists Chime, Bell, Drop and Soft. Click one to hear it and use it.
5.

**Choose a file** replaces the built-in sound with your own WAV or MP3. Once
one is stored, **Replac

e** and **Remove** sit beside its name.
6. **Preview** plays the current sound at the current volume

.
7. **Only when this window is in the background** keeps the chime quiet while the
window is visibl

e and focused.
8. **Reset sound settings** returns volume, sound and background-only to their
defaul
ts. It keeps a custom file.

Press `Escape` or click outside the panel to close it. Focus goes back to the
speaker row.
## When it rings

A ring means a Session went from working to idle. That covers the times you would
otherwise keep che

means a Session went from working to idle. That covers the times you would
otherwise keep checking:

- A normal answer finishing.
- A long plan, goal or workflow run ending.
- The model stopping to ask

a question, because the turn is waiting on you.
- A background or scheduled turn ending while you a
re in another conversation.

It does not ring when you open the page in the middle of a turn. The first status
sets the baseline,

and only a later running-to-idle change counts as an answer. It
also does not ring when a Session a
ppears or stays idle.

With **Only when this window is in the background** on, the chime stays quiet
while the page is visi

ble and focused. A visible but unfocused window counts as
background, because you are working somewh

ocused. A visible but unfocused window counts as
background, because you are working somewhere else.
## Custom sounds

A custom sound is a WAV or MP3 up to 5 MB and 30 seconds. The panel decodes the
file before acceptin

g it, so a file that is not really audio is refused with a
message instead of being played as noise.

The bytes stay in this browser's IndexedDB, so the file is never uploaded and
another browser cannot

see it. The clip is normalized to the same level as the
built-in sounds, so a quiet recording and a

loud one land at roughly the same
volume; the slider then scales both.

If the stored clip cannot be found or decoded later, the default chime plays
instead of leaving you

with silence. **Remove** clears it, and clearing the
site's data removes it too.
## Leaving it on in the background

Browsers do not let a page make sound until you have clicked or typed in it. The
plugin creates its

audio on your first click or keypress, then schedules the
notes on the audio clock, which does not a

dvance while sound is blocked. And if
you typed the prompt in this page, the chime plays even when t

he tab is in the
background and the screen is off. A custom clip is decoded from that first
gesture
too, so it is ready when a turn ends.
## Common questions

**I hear nothing.** Open **Audio settings** and check that **Play a sound** is on.
If it is, click o

nce in the page and send a short prompt; a page that has never
been clicked cannot make sound yet. C

heck the system volume and the tab's mute
state as well. At 100% the chime is about as loud as a nor

mal notification. If a
custom sound is selected and its file is gone, the default chime plays instea

d;
choose another file to replace it.

**Can I make it louder?** 100% is the top of the slider and is a normal
notification level. If you n

eed more, raise the system volume or the app's
volume. But the plugin does not boost above that.

**Can I change the sound or the volume?** The panel has four built-in sounds, a
custom WAV or MP3, a

nd a volume slider. Every sound is normalized to the same
